entities.summary: Luciano Tadeo Darderi is an Italian professional tennis player born in Argentina. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 18 achieved on 16 March 2026 and a best doubles ranking of No. 104 reached on 8 August 2022. He is currently the No. 4 singles player from Italy.
